claim_one_line: THE OBJECT HAS A LEAST-ACTION PRINCIPLE, PROVABLY ONLY AT THE DOUBLE TICK, AND THE OBSTRUCTION IS THE RECORD'S OWN GENESIS BIT. An attempt at TOE row 4 (dynamics) rather than a report on it, on the discrete dynamics the object actually has. THE JOIN: B21 banked 'the half-step trace map is anti-Poisson and its square is Poisson' in the twenties; B37 measured that the trace map has feedback and an invariant and then quarantined only the AWARENESS reading, leaving the mechanism unused; an already_banked sweep finds 4 corpus hits for 'feedback' in 1300+ arcs and ZERO settled arcs joining 'least action' to either. Nothing was cut; nothing was joined. (Q1) B21 recomputed from scratch, not taken on trust: Fricke-Vogt is a Casimir, det(DT) = -1, det(D(T^2)) = +1, and the bracket {x,y} = 2z - 2xy transports to minus itself. (Q3, THE THEOREM) a discrete Lagrangian L(a,b) generates through d2 L(a,b) + d1 L(b,c) = 0 a map that ALWAYS preserves omega = d1 d2 L da^db, so det +1; an orientation-reversing map of a surface preserves NO area form; hence AN ANTI-SYMPLECTIC MAP HAS NO DISCRETE LAGRANGIAN, and the object's fundamental tick admits no action principle at all -- confirmed independently by exhaustive solve over the general quadratic ansatz, where the DEL relation always reads q(a+c) + 2(p+r)b = 0, a and c sharing a coefficient while the recursion needs them opposite. (Q6e, the step that makes the theorem reach the object) T pulls the invariant Gelfand-Leray area form dx^dy/I_z back to MINUS itself on EVERY leaf, not only the one where the map linearises. (Q4, THE ECHO) the paper's genesis says 'the golden morphism is L.P, and orientation SQUARES it', and L.P = [[1,1],[1,0]] has det -1 and trace 1 while the linearised half step [[0,1],[1,1]] has det -1 and trace 1 -- the same characteristic polynomial lambda^2 - lambda - 1, the golden. ONE MECHANISM, TWO APPEARANCES: the genesis morphism is orientation-reversing because it carries the swap, the trace map inherits exactly that, and the same squaring repairs both. So the object itself says why the physical step is the DOUBLE tick: it is the first orientation-preserving one, hence the first with an action. (Q5) on the leaf I = 0 the map linearises to the Fibonacci recursion and the double step's generating function is S(u,U) = u^2/2 - uU + U^2, verified to reproduce the map exactly. (Q6, THE SCOPE CORRECTION, caught before banking) THE OBJECT IS NOT ON THAT LEAF: B1248 gives the once-punctured-torus fibre of m004 the parabolic commutator kappa = -2, the two corpus conventions relate as I = (kappa-2)/4, so the object's leaf is I = -1; the cosh linearisation is CHECKED to fail there and the explicit S does NOT apply to the object. What the object's leaf IS: x^2+y^2+z^2 = 2xyz, which under x = 3a/2 is MARKOV'S a^2+b^2+c^2 = 3abc -- the object's phase space is THE MARKOV SURFACE and the trace map on it is the Vieta/Markov move. The paper invokes Markov for the SELECTION of the parameter (Hurwitz extremality whose second value 2*sqrt2 is Markov's, the Markov root, the least real quadratic discriminant); the same surface is here the PHASE SPACE of the dynamics, and the corpus never joined those either. SCOPE, NOT A HEDGE: one degree of freedom on a surface is not a field theory -- no Lorentzian signature, no locality, no propagator. TOE row 4's requirement is UNTOUCHED and row 14's '4d dynamics is absent' remains true. What is no longer true is that the object supplies no variational structure at all.
